today.title: Today

prep.title: Getting ready
prep.text: The filing window opens on {open} and closes on {close}.

late.title: Past the usual filing date
late.text: File on ANEF as soon as possible and check with your préfecture.

expired.title: Your titre's expiry date has passed

exam.tooLate: Booked for {date} — results may arrive after the window closes ({close}). Ask the centre for an earlier session.
exam.missedBooking: Not booked, and the usual booking date ({date}) has passed. Book the earliest session you can.
exam.notBooked: Not booked. Book by {booking} for a session on or before {latest}.

today.deadlinesNote: Typical values: filing 4 → 2 months before expiry, results within ~4 weeks, booking ~3 weeks ahead. Confirm with your préfecture and exam centre.
today.pace: Pace: {n} new a day to see everything before {date}.
today.audioText: {clips} clips · ≈ {min} min — today's questions to listen to on the way to work.
today.levelNone: Not measured yet — take the 15-minute level check to see where you stand against B1.
today.levelStale: more than 2 weeks old, retake it
today.officialText: {n} knowledge questions published by the ministry, in your civic sessions. The answers are drafts: check each one against its official fiche.

check.noFiche: No fiche found — check on service-public.gouv.fr

session.spacing: Known questions come back in a few days, the others tomorrow — spacing them out is what makes them stick.
session.nothingDue: Nothing due right now — you're on track for today.

quiz.situationHint: A situation from daily life: choose the behaviour that follows French law and values.
quiz.draftHint: This answer was drafted from the official fiches and hasn't been checked yet. Compare it with the fiche, then tell the app.
quiz.listenHint: 2 plays max, like the real TCF.
quiz.noVoice: No French voice on this device — read it instead:
quiz.guessedHint: You'll see it again tomorrow instead of in a few days

card.notQuite: Not quite — the right answer is in green.

official.title: Official questions (CR)
official.intro: The {n} knowledge questions published by the ministry — 28 of the 40 exam questions come from this list (the 12 situational ones aren't published).
official.studyHint: Tap the proposition you think is right to test yourself. To make them stick, practise them as a session: the ones you miss come back until you know them.
official.found: 1 question found in all themes. | {n} questions found in all themes.
official.checkInfoTitle: The ministry publishes the questions only
official.checkInfo: The propositions and answers were drafted from the official fiches. Open the fiche, compare, then press “Matches the fiche” or “Something's wrong”. Start with “Check first”: the ones the drafter wasn't sure about.

level.title: French level check
level.intro1: About 15 minutes: three short parts (grammar & vocabulary, reading, listening) from A1 to B2, then a one-minute self-assessment for writing and speaking. Each part stops as soon as a level gets too hard.
level.intro2: Use headphones for the listening part (2 plays per item). No answers are shown during the test — you'll see your mistakes at the end.
level.intro3: This is an estimate to steer your practice, not a TCF / TEF score — the real tests use calibrated scales. Retake it every week or two.
level.selfTitle: Writing & speaking — tick what you can already do
level.selfHint: Be strict: tick a statement only if you could do it today, without preparing.

tip.gram: Do the grammar items in your French sessions and revise passé composé / imparfait, object pronouns and the subjonctif.
tip.ce: Read one short news article a day and sum it up in three sentences; do the reading items in your sessions.
tip.co: Listen to RFI « Journal en français facile » every morning and do the listening items in your sessions (2 plays max).
tip.ee: Write one TCF-style task a day (60–120 words) and compare it with the model answers.
tip.eo: Speak 5 minutes a day out loud — present your job, tell what you did yesterday, give an opinion — record yourself and listen back.

level.below: 1 skill below B1 | {n} skills below B1
level.scaleNote: Bars run A1 → B2; the outlined box is B1, the level required for the carte de résident.
level.gap: {band}, 1 level to B1 | {band}, {n} levels to B1

listen.title: Morning audio
listen.intro: Today's new civic questions, the ones you missed, and a few French listening exercises — question, 3-second pause to answer in your head, then the answer. Made for the metro: it keeps playing with the screen off.
listen.noVerifiedText: Check answers on the Official questions page, or turn off “Verified answers only”.
listen.saved: {saved} / {total} clips of today's mix are saved on this device.
listen.iosHint: On iPhone: open the app in Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen, then use it from the home-screen icon — it works offline there and Safari won't erase your progress.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataText: Progress is saved in this browser only. On iPhone, Safari can erase it after 7 days without a visit unless the app is added to the home screen — export a backup regularly.
settings.confirmImport: Replace your current progress with this backup?
settings.notBackup: This file is not a cr10-app backup.
settings.confirmErase: Erase all study progress (cards and daily log)? Your dates are kept.
